Package GUI

Class RegisterSubscriberController

java.lang.Object
GUI.RegisterSubscriberController
public class RegisterSubscriberController extends Object
Controller for the Subscriber Registration screen. This class allows a service representative to register a new subscriber by entering personal details, family size, and an optional credit card number. All user input is validated before being sent to the server.
